blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has described Vice President Sara Duterte as a “buwaon”, or liar, over her claim that the administration is desperate to bring her down, according to Palace Press Officer Claire Castro. At a briefing on Monday, Castro was asked to react to Duterte’s denial of allegations made by dismissed police corporal and former security aide Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., who claimed that he delivered suitcases containing more than P2 billion in cash to the Vice President, former President Rodrigo Duterte, and Davao City Rep.
